page_title: TikTok Shop Ads: Ad Types and Budget Split
og_title: TikTok Shop Ads: Every Ad Type and Where the Budget Should Go
title_html: TikTok Shop Ads: Every Ad Type and Where the Budget Should Go
description: TikTok Shop ads explained for brand operators: the five ad types, how to judge ad cost, how paid and affiliate content interact, and how to split the budget.
dek: TikTok lists five ad types for a Shop. Each one has a different job. Here is what each does, how cost should be judged, how paid and affiliate content feed each other, and where we would put the budget first.
author: Jackie He
cta_pre: Want a second read on where your ad budget sits?
llms_summary: A brand-operator guide to TikTok Shop ads: the five ad types TikTok lists (Product GMV Max, LIVE GMV Max, Product Shopping Ads, Video Shopping Ads, LIVE Shopping Ads), how to judge ad cost against unit economics, how paid and affiliate creator content interact, attribution caveats, a budget-order framework, and when to hand ads to an agency. Includes Reach case study results, no invented benchmarks.
